name: duplicate-sequence-rejected
description: Append-only invariant edge case: appending a second durable event that reuses an already-committed (session, session_sequence) pair. SqliteSessionStore enforces the invariant with a UNIQUE index and rejects the duplicate as StoreError::InvalidState at write time; JsonlSessionStore is an unindexed append-only file and legitimately accepts it. The divergence is recorded per store in each mutation's expect map.

captured_from.bug: Without the UNIQUE index on durable_events(session_id, session_sequence), a duplicate session sequence was silently written, corrupting replay order: load_session could no longer distinguish two events at the same position in the stream and the snapshot+event restoration contract became ambiguous.
captured_from.fix: migrations/0001_init.sql adds idx_durable_events_session_sequence (UNIQUE on (session_id, session_sequence)); map_sqlite_error in sqlite.rs surfaces the constraint violation as StoreError::InvalidState at write time. The JSONL backend keeps its documented append-only semantics (no index), so the per-store expectation below is the contract.
captured_from.replay: Apply the mutation transcript to a fresh store and assert each write's outcome against the per-store expect map.
